technical.summary: Short-term bullish structure (SMA cross, three white soldiers) conflicts with intermediate bearish setup (below 50/200 MAs, Ichimoku cloud); moderate confluence with elevated overbought conditions limits swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: PM shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 108 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction from senior members.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (319), and negative macro score (-4) create hostile environment despite low near-term earnings risk and falling dollar tailwind for PM.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross with three white soldiers and supertrend bullish provide short-term momentum structure in extreme fear environment (29/100) offering contrarian entry near support at 72.44.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental score of 2, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 319), price below both 50-SMA and 50-EMA, negative CMF/AO, and overbought StochRSI create a hostile setup where technical bounce lacks conviction and earnings risk looms in 108 days.
